main_text.l: ORITHYA, Marthesiæ filia, Amazonum post matrem
Regina, tum ob belli industriam, tum ob perpetuam virginita-
tem, conspicuam se, ac mirabilem præstitit. Hæc vbi coperit bel-
lum, vim quoque sororibus suis illatam ab Hercule & Theseo,
hortatur comites in vltionē, frustráque Ponti sinum & Asiam
domitam esse dicit, si Græcorum non tam bellis quàm rapinis
pateant. auxiliū à Rege Scytharum capit. Sed ante prœliū dis-
sensione orta, ab auxiliis desertæ Amazones, bellóq; ab Athe-
niésibus victæ, receptaculum tamen habuere castra sociorum,
in regnúmque reuersæ sunt. Iustin. lib. 2.
PENTHESILEA post Orythiam Amazonis impera-
uit. Hæc Troianis aduersus Græcos opem tulit. Verg. lib. Aen. 1.
Ducit Amazonidum lunatis agmina peltis
Penthesilea furens, mediisque in millibus ardet,
Aurea subnectens exerta cingula mamma
Bellatrix, audétque viris concurrere virgo.
Interfecta demum ab Achille, exercitúque eius absumpto,
paucæ quæ remanserant vsque ad tempora Alexandri Magni
durauerunt: quem Thalestris, Amazonum Regina, adiit, ad so-
bolem ex eo generandam. Hunc cum ter centum feminis salu-
tauit, cæteris iussis subsistere, copiam sui fecit ei Alexander per
tredecim dies. Hæc coram illi in os ingenuè fassa est se tantum
ad suscipiēdos liberos venisse: fœminini sexus se retenturam,
marem patri redditurā. reuersa in regnum, breui pòst tempore
cum omni Amazonum nomine intercidit. Quint. Curt. lib. 6.
Iustin. lib. 2. de hac vide etiam infra in Alexandro.

page.notes: Two engraved medallions (coins) above the text: left, a helmeted female head in profile facing right, inscribed "ORITHYA ΑΜΑ" (partly legible, around the rim); right, a female head in profile facing right with a diadem, inscribed "ΠΕΝΘΑΣΙΛΕΑ" with "ΑΜ" at the left rim. The inscriptions are not transcribed as text because they are part of the illustration. The Latin headings "ORITHYA" and "PENTHESILEA" are set in capitals; "PENTHESILEA" is treated as a level 2 heading. The verse lines are italic. Some printed letters in the first paragraph are slightly faded but legible.
